title: Liverpool Agree £120m Deal for Bradley Barcola From PSG
dek: Liverpool and Paris Saint-Germain have reached an outline agreement on Bradley Barcola's transfer, with the deal valued at approximately £120m (£100m guaranteed plus £20m in add-ons based on individual and team success). The compromise fee represents a significant reduction from PSG's initial £145m valuation. The deal's completion raises questions about winger Cody Gakpo's future at Anfield.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Liverpool have agreed to pay just over £100m guaranteed for France winger Bradley Barcola, with add-ons taking the total package to approximately £120m.
bottom_line: The outline agreement represents the breakdown of PSG's opening ask and sets the stage for completion of formal paperwork. What to watch: the announcement of a formal completion, confirmation that Barcola has passed his medical, and clarity on what Gakpo's status is and where he may be headed.
body:
Liverpool and Paris Saint-Germain have reached an outline agreement on the transfer of French winger Bradley Barcola following breakthrough negotiations Thursday night, per reporting from Guardian Sport and BBC Sport. The deal is valued at approximately £120m, comprising a guaranteed sum just over £100m with add-ons worth approximately £20m based on individual and team success.
PSG's initial £145m valuation posed a significant barrier to negotiations before the two clubs moved toward a compromise package Thursday. The add-ons are structured around performance metrics including individual and team achievements.
BBC Sport noted that Liverpool's progress on the Barcola deal has added to doubts surrounding Cody Gakpo's future at Anfield, though the sources do not detail the specific nature of those doubts or Gakpo's likely destination.
The sources do not specify when the deal is expected to be formally completed or publicly announced, whether Barcola has agreed personal terms, or the timeline for a medical examination.
